title: Degree-one scalar Ext cup with a degree-zero morphism
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a scheme. In the category of sheaves of $k$-vector spaces $K(X,k)$, use scalarExtCup [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. For arbitrary sheaves $A,B$, $a\in\operatorname{Ext}^1(\mathbf1,B)$ and a morphism $v:\mathbf1\to A$, one has $\operatorname{scalarExtCup}(a,\operatorname{mk}_0(v))=a;\operatorname{mk}_0(\rho_B^{-1};(B\mathbin{\triangleleft}v))$ and $\operatorname{scalarExtCup}(\operatorname{mk}_0(v),a)=a;\operatorname{mk}_0(\lambda_B^{-1};(v\mathbin{\triangleright}B))$.

source.place: Cohomology, section-cup-product, Lemma 20.31.1 (Tag 0FKU); Tag 01F7; Modules, Tags 0096 and 01CA

proof.text: For exact additive functors L,R and a natural transformation alpha from L to R, prove naturality of transport on Ext by induction on the degree. Degree zero is naturality on ordinary morphisms and mapExactFunctor_mk0. In successor degree embed the second object into an injective and express the class as a class composed with the connecting extension. The natural transformation gives a map from the short exact sequence mapped by L to the one mapped by R. Extension-class naturality and the induction hypothesis give the desired transport square. Sheaves of k-vector spaces have enough injectives by the Grothendieck abelian sheaf instance.

The exact functor identity comparison identifies transport through tensorRight-unit and tensorLeft-unit with the original Ext class, precomposed and postcomposed by the appropriate unitors. Postcompose the comparison by its inverse component to obtain the explicit transport formula.

Expand scalarExtCup and mapExactFunctor_mk0. For the right product insert the right-unit transport formula, cancel the unit unitor using equality of left and right unitors at the unit, and combine the remaining degree-zero compositions. For the left product first apply the transport naturality square for the transformation from tensorLeft-unit to tensorLeft-A induced by v, then insert the left-unit transport formula and cancel the left unitor. Associativity and mk0_comp_mk0 give the two formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtCup_mk₀ {A B : KSheaf X k}
    (a : Abelian.Ext.{u + 1} (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)) B 1)
    (v : 𝟙_ (KSheaf X k) ⟶ A) :
    scalarExtCup a (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ v) =
      a.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ ((ρ_ B).inv ≫ (B ◁ v))) rfl ∧
    scalarExtCup (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ v) a =
      a.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ ((λ_ B).inv ≫ (v ▷ B)))
        (by omega : 1 + 0 = 0 + 1)
